ground_stay.notes: 113 CONTINUOUS DAYS on the Provo ramp - the longest published stay by any aircraft in this investigation, covering 10 September. Only local flights were flown during it: Provo-Provo on 10 Jun and a 1:08 Provo-Provo on 5 Sep. Audit: 'ACCURATE POSS BROKEN JET GROUNDED IN PROVO' and 'ONLY LOCAL FLIGHTS WERE FLOWN IN AND AROUND PROVO FROM 10 JUNE-13 SEPT.' Owens: transponder ON on 10 Sep but the aircraft DID NOT TAKE OFF. COUNTERARGUMENT: a four-month stay is a maintenance-visit length, not a surveillance-orbit length. THE OWENS SHEET'S 7 JUL 2025 'GOOSEBAY-PARIS-CAIRO' ROW IS ENTERED TWICE (index 37 and 66) AND BOTH ARE FALSE - the aircraft was here the whole time.

rows.adsb_note: CORROBORATED, AND ON THE GROUND. A trace we pulled and kept puts this airframe on the ground 1.3 km from KPVU on the claimed date. It places NOBODY aboard.
rows.source: Owens Operation Mocking-Plane 17 Nov 2025; overlap page 20250910_UT_orem; SU-BND page
rows.counterargument: SU-BND was heard on the ground in two windows at the same spot (4 m apart), 16:05-17:34Z and 19:40-20:29Z, with nothing heard between: no takeoff and no switch log. Read at UTC-7, the four claimed times match those windows. Transponder cycles on a parked aircraft have ordinary explanations (APU, ground power, coverage gap). Time base not stated — UTC vs MT is the same class of error as the SU-BTT 7:08 correction. One reading of the same log puts power-on ~21 min before the shot, not 17 min after. Aircraft never moved.
rows.notes: Not a separate Owens-sheet index; it is the blue-plane half of 9/10, which the sheet's row 41 assigned to SU-BTT's (wrong-origin) departure.
